items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; not expected to play per Rapoport. Davante Adams has shown he can carry the load with elevated routes/targets.
items.why: No practice progress; McVay hopeful for Week 4 barring setback
items.implication: Adams WR1 upside with high target share/routes
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on routes without Nacua historically; recent 8-195-2

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; Mariota starts. Positive longer-term news per Rapoport.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin target share historically solid with Mariota but tough SEA matchup
items.opportunity: Backup QB impact on pass catchers

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at Indianapolis.
items.implication: Elevated TE targets; Schultz primary beneficiary
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% route targets and 28% target share without Collins last week

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach says Warren will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury; Warren shoulder but expected lead
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdowns; backups Homer/Heidenreich
items.opportunity: Warren lead snaps/carries/checkdowns; vertical pass not working for Rodgers

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in for main slate; hoping early clarity on Flowers/Moore/Mitchell.
Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
With Dowdle out, expecting Jaylen Warren to lead + spam checkdowns as vertical game failing for Rodgers; projecting Warren in despite Q.
items.why: Coach comments on Warren lead; practice squad backups
items.implication: High volume RB2/flex with receiving work
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; snaps when needs breather only

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT/air yards; LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins; IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.why: Volume + matchups; Collins out boosts Schultz

items.text: Fact: After Stevenson fumble, Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Brooks to IR pushes Hubbard to lead role (RB14 util).
Jahmyr Gibbs set new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim ceilings live; updates for news
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target/carry share in Lions offense

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rushing yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; tough run D), Travis Etienne vs LV (low snaps/touches even with Kamara), Terry McLaurin vs SEA (worst WR D + low team total).
items.opportunity: Henderson snaps rising post-Stevenson fumble; Hubbard lead with Brooks IR
